name: What is the typical process for foundation repair coordination with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for foundation repair coordination with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our coordination process at Hometelligent Inc. begins with a thorough site inspection to assess the foundation damage. We then engage a structural engineer to design a repair plan specific to your property. Following this, we handle all necessary permit applications with local city or county building departments in areas such as Fremont or San Leandro. Once permits are secured, we schedule the repair work with our experienced crews and oversee the project through to completion, ensuring quality and adherence to the engineered plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves site inspection, engineering design, permit acquisition, scheduling, and oversight of the repair work.
